resources.string: Full-device IPv4 route 0.0.0.0/0. IPv6 route ::/0 is captured and dropped, not tunneled. No DNS server is installed. No kill switch: when the tunnel is down, other traffic is not blocked. infinitumveilvpn.app is the product name, not a server.
Operator-provided peer. This is not a local test and not a built-in server.
